Generally ideas focus on either magnetizing Mars' iron core to create a natural magnetic field, or creating a completely artificial magnetic field by doing something like dragging an enormous electromagnet along the entire equator.

Terraforming would also be a centuries long process, so while I think we obviously should consider it as soon as possible there's also that allure of relying on distant future technology. Predicting Earth as it is today in the 1700s would be more akin to sci fi than intelligent speculation. And technology is now progressing a whole hell of a lot faster than it did in that 300 year period.
